experiment.title: Mendeley 金属杆温度试验：100al，三次完整重复采集
experiment.description: 已发表的真实金属杆热电偶测量数据；aluminum，100 温度档，同一预设试验组的文件 1/2/3 依次用于训练/开发/最终验证。仅使用六个原始温度测点，不增加空间插值点。
experiment.dataset_title: Data on the Validation to Determine the Material Thermal Properties Estimation Via a One-Dimensional Transient Convection Model

units.temperature: temperature excess above ambient, K (numerically equal to degrees C difference)

split_assignment_basis: All nine material × temperature groups fixed by filenames before examining development/final numeric values; suffix 1 training, 2 development, 3 final; full acquisitions, no rows subsetting.

unused_columns.7: Power (1023 Max): author heater command column, not used for identification; not interpreted as watts.

provenance.archive_source_claim: User-supplied SOURCE.txt says all 80 data files were SHA-256 verified against Mendeley metadata on 2026-10-27.
provenance.verification_performed: Local archive SHA-256, ZIP CRC, byte-preserving extraction, per-file SHA-256. SOURCE.txt claim is preserved but remote source hashes were not independently checked here.
provenance.condition_note: 50/75/100 denote temperature-test groups, not wind speeds. Author Temp-mode code assigns VV=5 as wind-speed guess for all 9 files per material; this is code metadata, not an independently measured wind-speed log.

provenance_note: 本次为论文作者采集并公开发布的真实金属杆实验数据复现（Mendeley Data，DOI: 10.17632/sbcf36976g.1；数据来源 https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/sbcf36976g/1），本项目未自行操作实验装置。输入来自用户提供的原始数据压缩包；已完成本地压缩包 CRC、SHA-256 与逐文件 SHA-256 校验，未独立核对远端 Mendeley 文件哈希。SOURCE.txt 中的远端哈希核对声明属于输入包附带声明。
